{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Shining Light
| Image = Event-ShiningLight.png
}}
{{E|Shining Light}} is an [[Event]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 1]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Enter}} {{TS|positive||Upgrade 2 random cards.}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* X is equal to 20% {{Asc|15|(30%)}} of the player's max HP.
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You find a shimmering {{TS|gold||mass of light}} encompassing the center of the room.
<br>
Its {{TS||up|warm glow}} and {{TS||up|enchanting patterns}} invite you in.
</div>

{{Frame|Enter}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As you walk through the light, you notice that the light is absorbed into you.
<br>
It's {{TS|negative|shake|scorching hot}} ! However, the pain quickly recedes.
<br>
You feel {{TS|blue||invigorated,}} as though you received a well deserved slap.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You walk around it, wondering what could have been.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 1: The First of Many!'''
** Cards from Shining Light event are now positioned correctly.
